body:
olivia: quick heads up — telemetry alerted on missing join-aggregates for 2026-04-10 02:20-02:50 UTC. consumer lag on the legacy topic caused out-of-order appends. we'll need a recompute for affected tenant groups but want to avoid blowing Dedicated burst.

samir: can we scope by tenant-group? which shards?

olivia: yes — groups alpha/charlie, shards 14-16. raw rows ~200k across groups but heavy duplication expected.

tara: ops preference: avoid single large spike. support a splitflow: auto-split by tenant-group, warm kv-cache, run deduped replay per group with a small cool-down between steps. console should show per-step token estimate + total.

leah: UI ask: add a "splitflow" toggle to the replay modal that shows a staged plan (warm -> replay alpha -> wait -> replay charlie). include an explicit expected peak tokens meter and a required checkbox if peak > 80k.

router-bot: preflight requested by olivia at 1799998008: `/api/replay/preflight {groups:["alpha","charlie"], shards:[14,15,16], window:[2026-04-10T02:20Z..2026-04-10T02:50Z]}`

router-bot: preflight result: alpha -> 68.4k tokens est, charlie -> 53.1k tokens est, total 121.5k, est_duplicates=~22k, slot_seconds=1800

samir: total > soft limit. auto-split plan looks right. we should warm caches for alpha first to shave tokens (~15-20%). also recommend running alpha during low-traffic window and charlie after 10m.

tara: ops checklist: (1) preflight -> (2) cache-warm per-group -> (3) dry-run per-group -> (4) live dedupe run per-group sequentially -> (5) post-verify counts. console should refuse live-run unless on-call approves overrides.

ops-bot: cache-warm scheduled for alpha at 1799998025. command: `/replay warm-cache --group alpha --shards 14,15,16`

ops-bot: cache-warm success. estimated savings for alpha 17%. updated alpha token estimate=56.7k.

router-bot: dry-run alpha complete: duplicates_found=9,800; token_estimate=56.5k; schema_ok

leah: will wire the UI to display the staged plan and per-step confirmations. add a required typed confirmation if any step > 70k tokens.

samir: note about routing: priority lanes map to dedicated-burst. fallback to shared-standard is allowed but currently the router strips X-Idempotency-Key AND X-KV-Cache-Tag on fallback. that was causing extra token burn last month. can we ensure both headers are preserved when failing over?

router-bot: noted. quick PR to copy X-Idempotency-Key and X-KV-Cache-Tag on fallback will be opened.

ops-bot: live alpha replay started (job r-20260410-111). command: `/replay run --group alpha --shards 14,15,16 --dedupe --route priority:dedicated-burst --quota-override 60k`

leah: dashboards: watching peak tokens and fallback rate. will flag if fallback > 1% or latency >1.7x.

ops-bot: mid-run alert: short spike in fallback (0.6%). router preserved headers after quick patch; no duplicate writes.

ops-bot: alpha job finished. tokens_used=56,300; duplicates_removed=9,712; fallback_rate=0.6%

olivia: wait 12m then proceed to charlie. tara, can you run the next warm + dry-run?

tara: running warm now. `/replay warm-cache --group charlie --shards 14,15,16`

ops-bot: warm finished. est savings=13%. updated charlie token estimate=46.2k.

router-bot: dry-run charlie complete: duplicates_found=12,300; token_estimate=46.0k

ops-bot: charlie live replay started with no quota-override (expect ~46k).

ops-bot: charlie finished. tokens_used=45,980; duplicates_removed=12,210; no SLOs.

samir: totals: tokens_used ~102k after warms, duplicates ~21.9k. splitflow kept peak under 70k, avoided heavy single burst.

leah: follow-ups: (1) add staged splitflow UX with per-step confirm and typed approval when step > threshold (leah), (2) router PR to preserve both headers on fallback (samir will review), (3) add splitflow example to runbook and recommended wait time between steps (olivia).

samir: PR opened for header passthrough, includes e2e for fallback.

olivia: thanks team. filing a short note in #postmortems and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
